The Finance Controls team helps management establish and maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting. We partner closely with control owners, Finance and Accounting leaders, Internal Audit, external auditors, Technology and Security teams, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional partners to strengthen the control environment and support reliable financial reporting.

As an Associate Manager, SOX & Internal Controls, you'll own a defined set of business processes within Coinbase's SOX and SOC 1 programs from end to end. Our Internal Controls team keeps Coinbase audit-ready by designing, documenting, and monitoring the controls that safeguard financial reporting across a fast-changing crypto platform. You'll bring a technology lens to controls work, mapping data flows from source systems to financial statements, evaluating automated control evidence, and driving remediation when gaps arise.

What you'll do:

- Own assigned SOX business processes end to end, including process narratives, risk-and-control matrices, key systems, automated controls, and business process controls, keeping each area audit-ready through continuous documentation and design updates.

- Partner with Technology, Engineering, Security Compliance, and Finance Analytics to scope IT general controls and IT application controls, map data flows, and evaluate the reliability of system-generated evidence.

- Lead day-to-day SOX and SOC 1 execution for your area, including risk assessment, scoping, walkthroughs, testing coordination, deficiency evaluation, and remediation tracking with control owners.

- Coordinate audit readiness and information requests with Internal Audit and external auditors, ensuring support is timely, complete, and well organized.

- Advise control owners on control design, evidence quality, and sustainable remediation while helping improve repeatable standards, playbooks, and evidence workflows across the function.

Required Skills and Experience:

- 6+ years in SOX, IT audit, internal controls, controllership, or a closely related controls function, with Big Four or public accounting experience preferred.

- Demonstrated ownership of a business process or controls workstream end to end, from documentation through testing and remediation, in a heavily automated, high-change environment.

- Working knowledge of ITGCs (access, change management, operations), IT application controls, and system-generated reports, with the ability to trace how a system supports a financial process.

As a Senior Investigator in Coinbase’s Financial Intelligence Unit within Compliance (2LoD), you’ll help drive Coinbase’s financial crime investigations capability across multiple jurisdictions. This team leads complex reactive and proactive investigations, develops intelligence on emerging typologies and risk patterns, and translates investigative insights into high-quality SAR/STR decisions, escalations and programme improvements. You’ll work on high-impact matters across Coinbase’s global platform, partnering closely with MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and cross functional stakeholders to protect Coinbase and its customers from financial crime. 

What you’ll do: 

- Own end-to-end investigations into complex AML/CFT matters, from alert review or referral, through case development, disposition and SAR/STR submission to relevant FIUs. 

- Conduct delegated MLRO reviews of Suspicious Transaction Reports and Suspicious Activity Reports prior to filing, ensuring accuracy, quality and regulatory defensibility.

- Lead proactive investigations, using transaction data, on-chain activity, trading behaviour and cross functional intelligence and OSINT to identify emerging typologies, threat patterns and high-risk activity.

- Develop actionable intelligence from casework and analytics to inform escalations, regulatory reporting, control enhancements and improvements to detection and investigation workflows.

- Partner internally with Country MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and other stakeholders on high-risk matters, information sharing and investigation strategy. 

- Partner with law enforcement agencies and external stakeholders on suspicious activity reporting, information requests, and intelligence sharing.

- Support investigation quality through case review, structured feedback and contributions to policies, procedures, training and programme maturity.

Required Skills and Experience:

- 4+ years conducting and reviewing complex crypto financial crime investigations including experience across a range of products such as retail and institutional transfers, spot trading and derivatives.

- Experience preparing, reviewing and filing SARs/STRs with strong understanding of multi-jurisdiction AML/CTF regulatory obligations and reporting expectations. 

- Demonstrated ability to perform data-driven investigations using SQL, blockchain analytics tools and other research techniques to extract investigative insights, identify suspicious behaviour and develop defensible conclusions.

- Strong investigative judgement and the ability to produce clear, structured long-form reports tailored to technical, compliance, leadership, and cross-functional audiences.

- Experience identifying financial crime typologies, contributing to proactive investigations and turning investigative findings into programme or control improvements.

- Bridge Fiat & Crypto Payment Rails: Architect unified checkout experiences that connect traditional payment rails (Apple Pay, Google Pay, debit/credit cards, bank transfers) with decentralized ecosystems, DeFi applications, and self-custodial wallets.

Required Skills and Experience:

- Proven Experience in Global Payments: 6+ years of technical product management experience with a deep understanding of payment service providers (PSPs), acquiring, authorization/settlement mechanics, and merchant acquiring ecosystems.

- Global Regulatory & Licensing Acumen: Solid familiarity with cross-border payment regulations, fintech compliance, and international licensing frameworks across major regions such as the US, EU, and LatAm.

- API & Developer Product Expertise: Demonstrated success designing, launching, and scaling developer-facing products, headless APIs, SDKs, and deep-link/OAuth integration frameworks.

- Cross-Chain & Web3 Knowledge: Working understanding of crypto transactions, stablecoins, self-custodial wallets, and cross-chain bridge/liquidity protocols.

- Support regulatory engagements, inspections, and information requests by organizing documentation, validating evidence, and helping prepare concise, accurate responses.

- Contribute to compliance training and awareness efforts for relevant stakeholders. Coinbase Singapore’s AML/CFT framework requires training materials and attendance records to be maintained and risk-based training to be delivered where required.

- Direct experience supporting regulatory license applications, major regulatory change programs, regulatory remediation or supervisory engagements in Singapore.

- Build and test tooling that uses frontier AI models to surface vulnerabilities across Coinbase’s products, working alongside senior engineers on design and review.

- Reproduce and verify reported vulnerabilities across common classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25), and write findings that engineering partners can act on.

- Experience with security tooling such as Burp Suite, Semgrep, fuzzing frameworks, or Metasploit.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Data Platform team within the Platform group, you will help build the systems that centralize all of Coinbase's internal and third-party data. The Data Platform team makes it easy for teams across the company to access, process, and transform data for analytics, machine learning, and powering end-user experiences. You'll contribute to the full spectrum of our systems, from foundational data storage and processing to scalable pipelines, frameworks, and internal applications that make data efficiently available to every team at Coinbase.

What you'll do:

- Own the design, development, and operation of foundational data services spanning cloud data warehouses, data lakes, orchestration (Airflow), batch processing (Spark, SQL), streaming (Kafka), query federation, and real-time event aggregation stores.

- Build and maintain data integration and processing SDKs used by internal services and product teams throughout Coinbase to interact with the data platform reliably at scale.

- Deliver self-service applications that empower users to manage, monitor, and troubleshoot their own data pipelines running on our platform infrastructure.

- Architect end-to-end data security and observability services, including access controls across multiple storage and access layers, data quality tracking, dataset cataloging, lineage, and usage auditing.

- Partner with data analysts, ML engineers, and security and compliance teams to convert functional requests into reusable, scalable patterns and assemble data microservices into platforms for critical business verticals.

Required Skills and Experience:

- 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, with hands-on experience building and operating data systems or data pipelines in production.

- Proficiency in Python, Go, or Java for backend development, with demonstrated ability to build services that process and serve data at scale.

- Experience with data infrastructure patterns including scale-out architectures, caching layers, key/value stores, and columnar storage systems.

- Hands-on experience with SQL, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, or similar data processing and orchestration frameworks in production environments.

- Experience with data security, access control, or data observability systems, including cataloging, lineage, or quality monitoring.

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Staff Software Engineer, Customer Administration

The Customer Administration Engineering (CAE) team is a core pillar of Coinbase's Enterprise Applications and Architecture (EAA) org, responsible for building and operating the secure, foundational platforms that power customer data operations across Coinbase. Our flagship product, Control Center, is Coinbase's secure system of action for internal specialists across CX, Compliance, Legal, Global Investigations, Trust and Risk, and dozens of other teams. It serves approximately 7,000 internal users via its UI and powers a growing ecosystem of internal tools and AI automation via its backend APIs and MCP. We are at an exciting inflection point: evolving Control Center from a human-specialist UI into a modular, AI-agent-ready operations platform. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical anchor for the CAE team, driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading the delivery of high-impact, cross-cutting platform capabilities.

What You'll Do

- Architect and deliver foundational platform capabilities including MCP tool registries, AI orchestration layers, risk-based access automation, and the away-team contribution model that enables product groups across Coinbase to build on the platform safely and at speed

- Drive the evolution of Control Center into an AI-agent-ready, headless operations platform, designing and implementing MCP procedure constructs, agentic guardrails, HITL orchestration, and evaluation frameworks that enable both human and autonomous AI agents to execute sensitive customer operations securely

- Partner with the Engineering Manager and Product counterparts to define architectural roadmaps, author TDDs, lead design reviews, decompose complex initiatives into deliverable milestones, and raise the engineering quality bar through code review and mentorship

- Build and maintain highly reliable, secure, distributed backend services, owning SLO definitions, observability instrumentation, incident response, and operational readiness for Tier-1 platform systems

- Collaborate across EAA engineering teams, Product Engineering, and Security Engineering to deliver cross-functional outcomes and drive shared platform primitives that eliminate duplicated infrastructure across the portfolio

Required Skills and Experience

- 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems in production, including deep proficiency in backend service design, API development (gRPC, MCP, GraphQL), and scalable microservices architectures

- Proven ability to independently lead ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives from whiteboard to production, writing high-quality, well-tested code and setting the standard for others across complex, multi-team problem spaces

- Strong experience with cloud-native infrastructure and the modern backend stack: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, BuildKite/CircleCI, event-driven architectures (Kafka, MQ), distributed caching (Redis/Memcached), and proficiency in SQL and/or NoSQL databases

- Track record of building secure, compliant internal tools or platforms, with deep appreciation for security controls, access management, audit logging, data governance, and engineering rigor in a regulated financial services environment

- Experience building or integrating with agentic AI systems, including MCP servers, LLM orchestration layers, RAG pipelines, HITL workflows, or evaluation and guardrail frameworks for production agentic workloads

- Proficiency in Go (Golang) as a primary backend language, with willingness to work across Python where applicable in the evolving AI stack

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

The Datastores team owns Coinbase's production online databases and caches: Aurora, RDS Postgres, MongoDB Atlas, DynamoDB, ElastiCache (Valkey, Redis), and ClickHouse. We build the paved paths, tooling, and client libraries that let hundreds of engineering teams run reliable, secure, cost-efficient data layers serving millions of requests per second. We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help evolve our storage platform: consolidating how databases are provisioned and operated, building zonal resilience and disaster recovery into every production datastore, securing access to data, and giving teams well-paved ways to use it.

What you'll do

- Shape the architecture and multi-year roadmap of Coinbase's storage platform across relational, document, key-value, and caching datastores.

- Lead platform initiatives from design through production, such as consolidating databases onto shared, proxy-fronted clusters and building client libraries that make applications resilient to failover.

- Drive resilience and disaster recovery for online datastores: zonal failover, backups and replication, restore tooling, and regular recovery validation.

- Harden the security and compliance posture of our datastores: encryption and key management, least-privilege access, audit logging, and the controls and evidence that regulators and auditors expect.

- Design for reliability, performance, and cost efficiency; set and defend SLOs, lead capacity planning, and eliminate recurring classes of incidents.

- Partner with senior engineers and product-group leadership on database technology choices, and work directly with AWS, MongoDB, and other vendors.

- Mentor engineers across the team, raise the bar on design reviews and operational excellence, and participate in the on-call rotation.

Required Skills and Experience

- 8+ years of industry experience building and operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems in production.

- Deep hands-on experience operating online databases at scale in production (e.g., PostgreSQL/Aurora, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis/Valkey, Memcached), including replication, failover, performance tuning, and version upgrades.

- Solid understanding of distributed database architecture, consistency models, and the trade-offs between datastore technologies.

- Experience securing data infrastructure in a regulated environment: encryption at rest and in transit, key management, access control, and audit requirements.

- Strong backend development skills in Go, Java, or Python, with a track record of building database tooling, client libraries, or automation.

- Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives, writing clear design documents, and influencing without direct authority.

- Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions
As a Threat Intelligence Platform Engineer on the Threat Intelligence team within Security Operations, you'll own Vertex Synapse in production - the platform that turns adversary intelligence into detections, blocks, and decisions across Coinbase. The TI team protects billions of dollars in digital assets by collecting, modeling, and operationalizing intelligence on the most sophisticated cyber threats targeting the crypto ecosystem. You'll keep the platform healthy, ingest and model new intelligence sources, and ship the automations that weave threat intelligence into the fabric of security operations at Coinbase.

What you'll do:

- Own the production Vertex Synapse instance, including platform health, backend operations, cron monitoring, and data hygiene

- Build and maintain intelligence feed integrations, enrichments, and tagging so new sources land modeled and usable by stakeholders

- Ship intelligence into downstream controls and data pipelines, including detections, blocklists, data warehouses, and agent workflows

- Partner across Security and Product to translate intelligence requirements into production capabilities

- Rapidly prototype and implement features, fixes, and tooling as required by the team's Intelligence Analysts and stakeholders

Required Skills and Experience:

- 2+ years building and operating threat intelligence platforms or security data pipelines in production environments

- Software development experience in Python, Go, and/or Storm, including deploying production-quality code with CI/CD ownership after ship

- Experience ingesting, modeling, tagging, and lifecycle-managing indicators and related intelligence data at scale

- Track record of troubleshooting and restoring production systems and data quality issues, then driving root-cause fixes to prevent recurrence

- Experience translating cross-functional stakeholder needs into technical solutions within a security operations context

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Position ID: P78174

#LI-Remote

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):
$144,500—$170,000 USD

- Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period.

- Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

- US Applicants: View Employee Rights, Know Your Rights, and E-Verify Notice of Participation.

- Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial.

- Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes.
